thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: us-east-1 high error rate — elevated 5xx and latency observed for Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Upstream egress to third-party auth provider (auth.example.com) and S3 failing intermittently. Thresholds crossed: p99 latency 1.2s -> 2.8s, 5xx rate > 12%. Paging on-call.

alice.sre: acked — I'm oncall. assigning priority P1.

ben.infra: seeing a spike in NAT gateway Connection Reset and route flaps in us-east-1-a/b. CloudWatch shows transient ENI detach/attach around 16:11 UTC. Third-party endpoints show TCP RSTs from our egress IPs.

carla.platform: customer-facing symptoms are token exchange failures (502) during login and some failed object PUTs to S3 (timeouts). CS reports 4 customers affected so far.

frank.oncall: I'm with alice, adding myself to the pager. will check routing ACLs and gw state.

alice.sre: can we confirm if this is our NATs or upstream provider? ben?

ben.infra: quick check:
```
aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filter "Name=tag:region,Values=us-east-1" --query "NatGateways[*].{Id:NatGatewayId,State:State,Subnet:SubnetId}" -o table
# show intermittent state changes for nat-0a1b2c3d
```
We also see a burst of SNAT port exhaustion on a few ENIs (connection churn). Cloud provider status has a 'networking events' note for us-east-1 around the same time.

dave.runtime: rolling fallback enabled for auth calls in the runtime (short-circuit to cached tokens and extended token TTL where safe). Pushing a hot patch to reduce token exchange frequency on busy connections.

carla.platform: note — Dedicated pools are showing increased queue latency because of retries. Suggest we enable routing-policy fallback to us-west-2 for non-data-local requests.

alice.sre: agreed — start gradual routing shift for stateless API requests to us-west-2, keep region sticky for stateful calls (S3 PUTs) until we confirm storage path. Adding steps: 1) increase local token cache TTL, 2) divert stateless traffic, 3) add additional retries with jitter for auth calls, 4) alert CS.

elaine.csm: we're drafting a short customer-facing note. Current impact: auth failures for interactive login, increased error rates for hosted API calls. ETA for next update in 15m.

ben.infra: executing network mitigation: forcing ENI reselection and reprovisioning affected NATs. Command run:
```
# reprovision NAT on affected subnets
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0new
```
I'll wait 1m for metrics to stabilize before routing change.

deploy-bot: All automated deploys paused for us-east-1 (safety hold).

alice.sre: pushing routing-policy override now (gradual 10% -> 50% -> 100 target for stateless paths). Watch for 5xx drop and latency improvements.

dave.runtime: applied cached-token TTL bump for runtime auth:
```
# runtime config snippet
auth.cache_ttl_secs: 900 -> 3600
auth.retry_policy: exponential_backoff(base_ms=100, max_ms=2000, jitter=true)
```
Also disabled immediate token exchange on cold start for a short window.

ben.infra: metrics update — after ENI reprovision + initial routing shift: 5xx rate down from 13% -> 6% in 5m, p99 latency from 2.8s -> 1.1s for stateless endpoints. S3 PUT timeouts still elevated.

carla.platform: S3 issues look like downstream egress to S3 public endpoints in us-east-1 are impacted. Options: 1) proxy S3 requests through alternate region, 2) fallback to multipart upload with smaller chunks and more retries. Both have tradeoffs for customer latency.

alice.sre: immediate plan: continue stateless redirect to us-west-2 at 100% for non-S3 operations, implement multipart+retries for S3 PUTs server-side, and enable temporary customer-level retries for affected buckets. Will keep Dedicated pools online but with degraded throughput.

frank.oncall: handover note for next oncall (grace.sre-lead at 16:35 UTC): action items outstanding: complete S3 fallback ramp, validate NAT reprovisioning across AZs, confirm with cloud provider timeline, prepare incident public note.

grace.sre-lead: acknowledged — will take follow-up. Please compile a short incident summary and customer impact list for postmortem.

elaine.csm: customer impact: 11 high-usage customers saw auth errors or upload timeouts between 16:09–16:27 UTC. Affected customers: AcmeCorp, NimbusHealth, CampusAI (internal list saved). We're sending interim communication mentioning service degradation and our mitigation steps.

alice.sre: timeline so far (for postmortem):
- 16:09 UTC: spike in NAT gateway ENI churn and SNAT port exhaustion detected
- 16:11 UTC: incident-bot page triggered (5xx > 10%)
- 16:12–16:17 UTC: infra reprovision NATs and start route-table updates
- 16:18 UTC: runtime caching & retry config pushed
- 16:21 UTC: routing-policy partial shift begins
- 16:24 UTC: 5xx rate falls to ~6% for stateless endpoints
- 16:30 UTC: S3 multipart fallback in progress; still monitoring

carla.platform: note for mitigation doc: consider longer-term changes — add NAT pool scaling based on ephemeral port utilization, implement egress path diversity, and add synthetic auth endpoint checks (end-to-end) to detect earlier.

ben.infra: cloud provider update: they reported a regional networking impairment affecting some NAT/ENI attachments in us-east-1. They estimate mitigation window 30–60m earlier but will confirm.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: mitigated -> partial (stateless paths healthy, stateful/storage still affected). Incident owner: alice.sre. Severity downgraded to SEV2 for tracking of storage fallthrough.

grace.sre-lead: assigning postmortem owner: ben.infra + carla.platform. Please include timeline, root cause analysis, remediation, and customer impact table.

elaine.csm: customer note ready for send (subject to legal/PR approval). We'll hold until final status change.

alice.sre: final operational note before handoff to next oncall: keep routing-policy in place until cloud provider confirms full network stability. If 5xx resurges >5% re-open pager.

frank.oncall: handing off to grace.sre-lead at 16:35 UTC — details in follow-up thread. :white_check_mark:

grace.sre-lead: I have control. closing this live coordination thread. will open a dedicated postmortem thread in #postmortems and link customers + notes.

deploy-bot: Safety hold for us-east-1 lifted at 16:45 UTC.

alice.sre: closing incident channel for live mitigation. Postmortem to be created with assigned owners. Great job team. :clap:
